items.title: Scanner Release Notes
items.content_html:
Scanner Release Notes¶

Subscribe to release notes (RSS)

Get notified automatically whenever a new connector or scanner version ships — no account or sign-up required.

How to subscribe: open the release notes feed, copy its URL from your browser's address bar, and add it to any RSS reader — for example Feedly, Inoreader, NetNewsWire, or Thunderbird. For team alerts, use Slack (/feed subscribe <feed URL>) or add the RSS connector to a Microsoft Teams channel. Your reader then checks the feed periodically and flags each new release for you.

Opening the feed URL directly in a browser shows raw XML — that's expected, because browsers have no built-in feed reader. Paste it into one of the readers above to see it as a formatted article.

The latest scanner version is available for download from the platform administration.

July 30, 2026 — Version 100¶

Enhancements

Added support for data profiling on connectors based on the public SDK, where profiling is implemented.
